A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Hassium (하슘) itself — the sovereign of the Hassium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a mature, poised woman; olive skin; heart-shaped face; deep-set eyes; pale silver-grey eyes; thick straight brows; straight narrow nose; soft medium lips.
Body and hair: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist build; a sculpted shoulder-length brushed-back bob with a clean centre part; deep beech-forest green hair with red-sandstone lowlights and warm autumn-gold glints like turning beech leaves.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed.
Her element, carried in her design: hassium: a heavy synthetic metal below osmium, first made in 1984 by striking lead with iron ions in a research city, and named in Latin for the forested hill state around it, a land of deep beech and oak woods, red sandstone castles on wooded ridges and old fairy tales gathered there by two brothers; in 2001 a few atoms were turned into a volatile oxide gas just as osmium is, proving it a true heavier osmium, and one of its forms sits on a doubly magic shelf of unusual stability.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Beech-green and osmium blue-grey light armor with ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles like the turning stabilizer rings of a floating castle, each ring edged with autumn-gold light and engraved inside with a fine beech-leaf pattern, red-sandstone trim on the shoulder plates, a small castle-tower crest core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar;. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Design idea: Two concentric layers of dense osmium-blue armored plates interlock along the rigid coat, with a red-sandstone colored keystone latch at the upper chest.
Colours: deep beech-forest green, red sandstone, osmium blue-grey metal, autumn beech gold.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a forest state of floating citadels: forest-covered island castles held aloft by slowly turning ring stabilizers, bridges of light linking one citadel to the next, and deep beech woods growing on their upper terraces.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: Both unoccupied hands rest naturally at her sides.
Setting detail: A floating terrace over a lower citadel with a ring stabilizer in view.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Hs) and atomic number (108) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
